title: Why does my effect run twice?

slides.say: Your effect runs twice in development. It's not a bug, it's a test.

slides.text: In dev, Strict Mode mounts → unmounts → mounts again.
slides.say: In development, strict mode mounts your component, unmounts it, then mounts it again, on purpose.

slides.text: The fix: return a cleanup function.
slides.say: It checks that your effect cleans up after itself. Return a cleanup function that undoes what the setup did.

slides.text: Production runs it once. Don't fight it, fix the cleanup.
slides.say: In production it only runs once. So don't try to block it. Write a proper cleanup instead.
